"202401052 BE700DVT" and "Rev1.0sp1" is silkscreened on the board. {{See also|TP-LINK PCB ID|TP-LINK Archer BE series}}
===Variants=== Product description: *BE15000 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Router, BE11000 Tri-Band Wi-Fi 7 Router
Type designation: *Archer BE700, Archer BE700 Pro, Archer BE11000 Pro
Note: All versions of the Model: Archer BE700, BE700 Pro and BE11000 Pro :are electrically equal except the following difference: *The only difference between the models is in the design of the RJ45 port. :Other designs (including hardware and software) are the same. *BE700 with 1Gbps ports, BE700 Pro and BE11000 Pro with 10Gbps port. *BE11000 Pro has the different model and product name from BE700 Pro, :others are exactly the same.
